vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.0

The persona-customer-support skill bundle is a standard configuration for managing customer support tasks using Google Workspace integrations. The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose of triaging emails, logging tickets in spreadsheets, and scheduling follow-ups, with no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (customer support via Google Workspace tooling) matches its instructions and requirements; it is an instruction-only wrapper that calls a 'gws' CLI and related gws-* utility skills, and nothing in the SKILL.md asks for unrelated secrets or system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (customer support) match the runtime instructions (triage Gmail, convert emails to tasks, append to Sheets, post to Chat, schedule Calendar events). Declared required binary 'gws' and the listed utility skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) are appropriate for the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to invoking gws commands for mailbox triage, workflow conversion, sheet updates, chat escalation, and calendar insertion. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading arbitrary local files, accessing unrelated environment variables, or sending data to unknown external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files, so it does not write or execute new code on disk. That lowers install risk. The only runtime dependency is a preinstalled 'gws' binary (no download URLs or extracts are present).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself declares no required env vars or credentials, which is consistent. However, it depends on other gws-* utility skills and the 'gws' binary, which in practice will require Google Workspace credentials/authorization. Users should confirm what credentials those dependent utilities request and ensure least privilege.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent/always-on privileges or system-wide configuration changes. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with other concerning privileges here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and simply instructs a Google Workspace CLI and related utility skills to manage support tickets. Before installing or invoking it, verify the origin of the 'gws' binary and the gws-* utility skills (they will likely require Google credentials with access to Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar). Prefer obtaining the gws tool from an official source, review the scopes/permissions those utilities request, and apply least-privilege account credentials (e.g., an account or service account dedicated to support automation rather than a personal admin account). If you need provenance assurance, prefer skills with a known homepage or source repository; the registry metadata here lacks a homepage/source URL.
